cases.split: 100 checks (50 checksum variants -- 10 lens x 5 patterns -- x 2 generator states: null and FileChecksumGenCrc32c) + 100 edge (10 checksum values x 2 generator states x 5 conditions: canary ok, canary bad, generator throws, throw with bad canary, generator returns empty -- pinning that the canary is checked on the null path too, that a throw beats the canary check, and that gen_throws is vacuous with no generator) + 100 bindings (25 (generator, checksum) pairs x 4 recorded invariants: body_sha256, source_sha256, fde_record, caller_census -- each row records the invariant's expected value and replay compares it)
what_is_checked: checks: a null generator always returns the empty string (kUnknownFileChecksum), for every checksum variant; a present generator returns its GetChecksum value verbatim, including empty and binary (NUL/0xff) payloads

edge: a bad canary fails on both paths (present and null); a generator throw propagates and beats the canary check (the throw happens inside the virtual call, before the check); with no generator, gen_throws has no effect but the canary check still applies

bindings: the result depends only on the writer state, the generator's returned checksum and the canary, never on the caller site; each bindings row records its invariant's expected value (body hash, source hash, FDE record, 6-site caller census) and replay compares it
